title: A-TownChain / KAI-OS L0-L9 System and X1-X36 Cross-Cutting Layer Registry

authority.rule: Catalog is a control-plane artifact; it does not replace canonical implementation repositories or establish implementation/verification status.

status_contract.verification_rule: VERIFIED requires exact full implementation commit SHA plus terminal workflow run/job/step/exit code and log or artifact hashes. Source mapping or green CI alone is insufficient.
status_contract.exclusion_rule: EXCLUDED requires a reason and approval/evidence reference; never infer exclusion from a missing record.

system_layers.name: Hardware & Compute
system_layers.purpose: Physical compute resources, hardware identity/capability discovery, CPU, GPU, NPU, memory, storage, security hardware, connectivity, I/O and power/thermal capabilities. L0 provides capabilities but grants no permissions; boot, firmware and HAL responsibilities belong to L1.
system_layers.canonical_ownership_rule: Hardware capability contracts are specified at the architecture/HAL boundary; map concrete device/HAL implementation only after source inspection. No ambient authority is implied.
system_layers.notes: Selected as the L0 system-layer definition for this architecture baseline. Historical Issue #71 'System & Network' naming remains a recorded conflict requiring downstream reference reconciliation; this decision does not claim functional verification.

system_layers.name: Boot, Firmware & Hardware Abstraction (HAL)
system_layers.purpose: Firmware interfaces, boot stages, hardware discovery, CPU/platform abstraction, drivers and hardware capability profiles. Does not own OS policy above HAL.
system_layers.canonical_ownership_rule: Map to actual GlobusOS boot/HAL modules after source inspection; do not guess paths.
system_layers.notes: Definition is an architecture scope contract. It does not assert implementation completeness or functional verification.

system_layers.name: ShivaCore Kernel / Trusted Computing Base
system_layers.purpose: Capability microkernel, isolation, scheduling primitives, memory protection, secure IPC and kernel security invariants.
system_layers.notes: Definition is an architecture scope contract. It does not assert implementation completeness or functional verification.

system_layers.name: GlobusOS System Services & OS Architecture
system_layers.purpose: System service lifecycle, IPC clients/servers, storage/network services, service management, OS APIs and policy integration.
system_layers.notes: Definition is an architecture scope contract. It does not assert implementation completeness or functional verification.

system_layers.name: GlobusOS Desktop, Window Manager & UI
system_layers.purpose: Compositor, windows, taskbar/launcher, input, display, accessibility and desktop interaction.
system_layers.canonical_ownership_rule: `globus-os`, exact module paths to be evidenced.
system_layers.notes: Definition is an architecture scope contract. It does not assert implementation completeness or functional verification.

system_layers.name: A-TownChain Blockchain Core
system_layers.purpose: Node, protocol, transaction processing, state transition, networking, storage and consensus integration.
system_layers.notes: Definition is an architecture scope contract. It does not assert implementation completeness or functional verification.

system_layers.name: ATC-VM & Smart-Contract Execution
system_layers.purpose: Bytecode validation, deterministic execution, stack/state semantics, gas/resource limits and contract execution interface.
system_layers.canonical_ownership_rule: `a-townchain/components/vm` canonical ATC-VM. No standalone duplicate production VM.

system_layers.name: Developer Platform & ATCLang
system_layers.purpose: Language tooling, lexer/parser, semantics, compiler/artifacts, SDKs, diagnostics and developer workflows.
